summary: Checked all 35 estimates against the entire supplied markdown and the cited PDF pages, and inspected Figures 1, 2, and 4 in memory. All 46 non-null numerical statistical entries, their outcome/arm assignments, and the printed count values were confirmed. The observation counts are documented totals for the full regression analyses, not two-arm subtotals. Found one repeated coding error: 31 evaluator-rated estimates record se_basis=rating even though the paper clusters uncertainty by evaluator. Record evaluator clusters and retain the warning that these are not the randomized-writer clusters required for pooling. The other requested outcome, design, direction, timing, and unit codes were confirmed. No in-scope full-sample outcome or contrast is missing from the supplied article; figure-only statistics appropriately remain null. The separate supplementary sections S1-S9, tables S1-S18, and figures S1-S6 are not present in the supplied ten-page PDF or its markdown, so their contents could not be verified.
